Scarab Of Protection changes death to unconsciousness - DC 18 Constitution check required.

GMs: Remind players the Scarab Of Protection's DC 18 Constitution check is for when death truly matters, not every scrape.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Open a Kobold Inventor scene with stakes on both sides, then force a choice that costs something either way.

DMs: make them choose what they can live with: save everyone at higher risk, or end the threat before collateral climbs.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Patron displeasure incoming: Child of Bobugbubilz.

Judges: Position the Child of Bobugbubilz in water to exploit its 30' swim speed and force foes into its blood drain.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Dying characters face a harsh reality - each round they must make a DC 15 CON check or die.

GMs: Enforce DC 15 CON checks at the start of each round for dying characters to maintain order and avoid disputes.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Necklace of Fireballs can escalate damage quickly - each additional bead adds 1d6 damage, up to 12d6 total.

DMs: Wait for enemies to cluster, then use the Necklace of Fireballs to hit them with multiple beads for maximum damage.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

The Dice Chain replaces standard bonuses - shifts the die size from d3 to d30 instead.

Judges: When players stack bonuses, shift their dice up the chain - d3 to d30 - so they feel the weight of their choices.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Berserker's Rage adds unexpected damage - +1d4 for 3 rounds once per day.

GMs: Trigger Rage when players cluster, forcing them to endure the +1d4 damage boost with no easy escape.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Immunity often leads to misunderstandings in combat - it means no damage or condition effects at all.

DMs: Immunity means zero damage or effect; remind players not to waste actions on immune targets.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.
